title: ESP, Teleports, fly, anti-fall, godmode parts, auto qte
features:
**This script does not redirect you to sites like Linkvertise; it simply requires a single, permanent key from Discord that everyone can use. Enjoy.**

TP to End (Use on Green Light) — teleports to the Red Light/Green Light end area.

Remove Injury — removes injury effect

Dalgona
Get Free Lighter

Hide & Seek
Kill Hiders — kill aura that targets players marked as hiders.

Teleport 100 Stud Up

Teleport 50 Stud Down

Hider ESP — highlights hiders.

Seeker ESP — highlights seekers.

Key ESP — highlights dropped keys.

Escape Door ESP — highlights exit doors.

Jump/Glass
TP to End (Jump Rope) — teleports to the jump rope end.

Delete The Rope — removes the rope effect.

Anti-Fall — creates a giant wall to prevent falling.

Glass Bridge ESP — colors glass panels:

Green = safe

Red = evil/bad

Yellow = delayed breaking

Place Fake Parts — creates platforms over evil glass.

Destroy Fake Parts — removes placed platforms.

TP to End (Glass Bridge) — teleports to the glass bridge end.

Rebellion
Auto-Shoot Guards — auto-fires at guard NPCs using the gun remote.

NPC Guard ESP — highlights guards.

Expand NPC Guard Hitbox — enlarges guard head hitboxes.

Mingle
Auto QTE — automatically fires the QTE remote event.

Teleport Mingletron Room — teleports to the Mingletron room.

Final
Squid Game Killaura — kill aura for the final Squid Game fight (only when ≤7 players alive).

Squid Game Godmode — creates a floating part and teleports you onto it.

Sky Squid Godmode — creates a large floor to prevent falling.

Playable Guards
Auto-Shoot (Guard) — auto-fires at players marked as killable by guards.

Enable Fly (Beta) — PC-only fly using WASD, Space, Ctrl.

Auto Win Boxing Minigame — fires the StrengthTesterResult remote to auto-win.

Player Query
Dropdown to select a player.

Check Player — shows:

Name, DisplayName, UserId

Stats: Level, Won, Wins, WinStreak, AFK Coins

Upgrades: Strength Boost, Faster Sprint, Won Boost

Gamepasses: 2x Vote, Custom Tag, Emote Page, Glass Manufacturer, Perm Guard, VIP

Equipped Guard Power, Equipped Power, Inventory Power

Refresh Player List

Player
Theme Settings — dropdown with themes: Blossom, Rose, Vaporwave, Rainbow, Light, Horizon, MonokaiPro, Plant, Midnight, Nebula.

Player ESP — highlights other players with name/health.

Teleport Lobby

Teleport Safezone

Get VIP (Visual) — sets VIP attribute visually.

Teleport to Player — dropdown + button.

Refresh Player List
